snippet.title: Nick Eh 30 Saved GTA 6..
snippet.description:
NickEh30 kicked a dog in GTA 6, robbed a train full of NPCs, and kept calling the streams family friendly. But his biggest clip of launch week was the one where he said the game bored him. So how did the guy who called GTA 6 boring end up making it look like the most fun game of the week?

CHAPTERS

0:36 He called GTA 6 boring
1:48 The family friendly promise
2:43 The dog
3:57 The boat
4:34 The train
6:32 Was anybody actually mad?
7:29 Did he save GTA 6?
